messages:
maria: quick sync: kv-cache eviction spike last night triggered several downstream latencies. want to capture concrete follow-ups for tests and owners so this doesn't recur.

sam: thanks — curious which specific failure patterns we saw? eviction bursts or long-tail evictions?

maria: both. short burst at t=22:14 caused cache thrash; later we saw elevated eviction_rate and increased miss-stalls for ~7m. logs in s3://redwood-ops/evictspike-2026-03-21.

lee: i'll own replay/regression infra. plan: take raw requests, build a sampled replay, run against master/canary and collect eviction metrics. target: smoke by Thu, full run by next Wed.
jordan: i'll take ownership of prompt/regression corpus. noticed ~10 prompts that show degraded end-to-end latency due to extra KV lookups. will add a focused promptset "kv_prefix_misroute" and create an eval. draft by Fri EOD.

anya: i'll coordinate a chaos drill (network + simulated capacity pressure) for next Monday 03:00 PT and will be oncall for the drill. sam, can you confirm roster?
sam: yep i can rotate with anya. i'll also add a weekly cron that runs the critical regression against canary builds and posts results to #eng-sre. suggestion: fail the canary roll if eviction-related false positives increase by >3%.

ci-bot: Created issue RED-4642 (kv-cache-replay-and-regression) assigned lee due: 2026-04-01; Created issue RED-4643 (kv-prefix-promptset) assigned jordan due: 2026-03-27.

maria: summary of action items: 1) replay + regression harness (owner: lee) 1) promptset + eval scenario (owner: jordan) 3) scheduled chaos drill (owners: anya/sam) 4) weekly canary cron + gate (owner: sam) 5) add eviction-rate alert with 5m window (owner: jordan + ops).

lee: quick notes: put my k6 script under infra/tests/kv_replay/k6_kv_replay.js. sample command: `k6 run infra/tests/kv_replay/k6_kv_replay.js --vus 100 --duration 15m`. will link raw replay artifacts and comparison graphs to RED-4642.
jordan: for the eval pipeline, i'll add an SLO gate that runs the kv_prefix_misroute set against baseline and candidate; PR will include a small baseline rerun and threshold check. aim: PR by Mon.
sam: i'll update the postmortem doc and add these tickets to the remediation board. also will request reserved infra (2x p3) for the regression runs next week.
maria: thanks all. please put owner + due date in the ticket and ping here when done so i can close the retro action. closing thread when RED-4642/4643 have owners + dates. :white_check_mark:
